title: The Republic VS Micheal Ah-kon CO 34/2024 (19 January 2026 [2026] SCSC 4
text:
SUPREME COURT OF SEYCHELLES
Reportable
[2026]
C034/2024
Inthe matter between:
THE REPUBLIC Prosecution
(rep. by Ms. Alcindor)
versus
MICHAEL AH-KON yd Accused
(rep. Mrs. Amesbury)
Before: Govinden CJ
Heard: 19 January 2026
th
Delivered: 19 January 2026
th
BAIL CONDITIONS
GOVINDEN CJ,
[I] The 3 rd Accused inthis case isto be released on the following bail conditions;
I) Report to the Central Police Station every Monday at 9am for your registration.
2) Surrender any traveling documents that you might have or passport in your
possession to the Registrar of the Supreme Court.
3) Not to commit any offence during the course of your bail.
1

Signed, dated and delivered at lie du Port on 19th January 2026.
Govinden, CJ
